objective: Replicate fixed-baseline local-error constructs on the outcome-blind isolated Haze4K official-test development partition, distinguish cross-synthetic pattern replication from oracle qualification, and keep the candidate-confirmation partition unavailable during development.

haze4k_test_local_error_replication.core_assumption: The fixed official Haze4K ConvIR-B exhibits a SOTS-consistent local-error pattern on the isolated 100-scene Haze4K test development partition.
haze4k_test_local_error_replication.close_condition: Close after the single frozen 100-scene replication regardless of terminal decision.

haze4k_test_local_action_oracle.core_assumption: Stable local errors occur often enough that a bounded non-deployable keep, weaken, or strengthen action oracle may have material scene-level headroom.
haze4k_test_local_action_oracle.close_condition: Close after one frozen bounded-action oracle or if the replication does not authorize it.

nh_haze_construct_audit.core_assumption: The operational local-error constructs remain measurable and interpretable on an explicitly development-role real nonhomogeneous-haze subset without using sealed external validation.
nh_haze_construct_audit.close_condition: Close after one frozen real-domain construct audit; it cannot replace later sealed NH-HAZE validation.
